intro.text: An Idrian slumlord living in T'Telir.

items.text: Rira was very young when his father brought him to Hallandren, and his father died working the dye fields, gathering the Tears of Edgli. Rira climbed through the Idrian underworld until he had the power of a slumlord, buying Breath and running prostitution.

He helped pay for Vahr's attempted uprising among the dye workers and lost a great deal of money when Vahr was captured. When Vivenna came to meet him, along with Ashu and Paxen, he said he was honoured and asked what she had been doing in the city.

His support came at a price: he wanted Vivenna's sister Fafen promised to him in marriage. He considered war between Hallandren and Idris unavoidable, and when Vivenna showed her disgust he retorted that he looked after the Idrians better than she could.

appearance.text: A handsome man of at least the First Heightening, perhaps the Third, who dresses sloppily but with an easy, relaxed air.

personality.text: Wealthy and self-indulgent, he runs much of the crime in the Idrian slums yet sincerely believes he has served his people, keeping them fed by whatever means it takes. He backs an Idrian uprising only as far as it suits him. He calls himself a patriot but expects patriots to be rewarded, which repels Vivenna.
His faith in Austre remains strong: he scolds Vivenna for judging him against the Five Visions, and under his shirt he wears a small Austrin charm of obedience bearing his parents' names.
